prompts.title: Golden Hour on the Deck
prompts.prompt:
Create a stunning anime-style cinematic illustration of a confident man(face match) standing on a modern waterfront deck during a warm golden-hour sunset. He  wears sleek black rectangular sunglasses while gazing slightly to the right with a calm, confident expression. He is dressed in an oversized off-white short-sleeve button-up shirt tucked into tailored black high-waisted trousers with a black leather belt, complemented by a minimalist black wristwatch. His left elbow rests casually on a white railing while his other hand is tucked into his pocket, creating a relaxed yet elegant pose.
The background features shimmering turquoise water, a distant mountain range, and a glowing sun suspended in a pastel peach-and-orange sky filled with soft scattered clouds. Warm sunlight casts gentle golden rim lighting across the character, creating soft highlights and subtle shadows. The atmosphere is peaceful, cinematic, and luxurious with vibrant colors, painterly reflections on the water, and a serene summer ambiance.
Composition: Waist-up portrait, eye-level camera angle, subject positioned slightly off-center using the rule of thirds, vertical composition (4:5 aspect ratio).
Style: Premium modern anime illustration inspired by Makoto Shinkai aesthetics, ultra-clean linework, soft painterly shading, vibrant cinematic color grading, detailed fabric folds, expressive lighting, crisp facial features, highly detailed environment, depth of field, masterpiece quality, ultra-detailed, 8K.

prompts.title: The Smirking Drifter
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed, semi-realistic digital illustration of a stylish man in a modern streetwear aesthetic. The composition is a vertical medium portrait, framed from the upper torso to just above the head. The subject is positioned slightly off-center with his body turned in a subtle three-quarter profile while his head is tilted back toward the camera, making confident, direct eye contact. His expression is calm, self-assured, and slightly mysterious with a faint smirk.
The man has thick, voluminous black hair with finely rendered individual strands and highly detailed texture. His skin has a warm-yellow complexion with smooth shading, subtle highlights on the cheekbones and nose bridge, and clean, stylized facial detailing.
He is dressed in a premium black oversized high-collar windbreaker jacket made of matte technical fabric. The jacket features realistic stitching, soft folds, zipper details, snap buttons, and a raised collar partially covering the neck. On the upper sleeve is a rectangular embroidered patch reading "PROMPT PLUM CULTURE" in yellow lettering on a black background.
A vibrant mustard-yellow backpack is worn over both shoulders, with thick padded shoulder straps, adjustable buckles, reinforced stitching, and visible fabric texture. The bright yellow backpack creates a bold contrast against the black jacket and acts as the primary accent color.
The background is a clean, seamless solid golden-yellow studio backdrop with a subtle gradient and no distractions, emphasizing the subject. Lighting is soft yet directional from the upper front, creating gentle shadows beneath the jawline, around the collar, and within the hair while producing crisp highlights across the face and backpack straps.
The artwork combines hyper-detailed anime-inspired realism with premium editorial illustration, featuring clean vector-like linework, painterly shading, ultra-sharp edges, realistic fabric textures, detailed hair strands, expressive facial rendering, and vibrant yet balanced color grading. Maintain a polished, high-end fashion editorial look with excellent contrast, depth, and clarity.
Style: Modern digital illustration, semi-realistic character art, anime-inspired realism, fashion editorial, premium poster artwork.
Color Palette: Black, mustard yellow, warm-yellow skin tones, subtle golden highlights.
Camera Angle: Slightly low-angle, medium portrait, 85mm lens equivalent.
Quality: Ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, razor-sharp focus, crisp linework, professional digital painting, clean background, high dynamic range, premium commercial illustration quality.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Casual Anime-Style Selfie with Graffiti
prompts.prompt:
Create a detailed portrait semi-realistic illustration of a confident man. He is striking a pose for a self-reflection mirror selfie, positioned slightly to the left of the frame. He holds a dark grey smartphone with his right hand, angled to reveal the camera lenses facing the mirror, while his left hand is casually placed in his pants pocket. He is looking intently at the phone's screen.
Outfit & Accessories
He is dressed in a fashionable, laid-back urban outfit, featuring an oversized black short-sleeved button-up shirt that is unbuttoned at the top. He wears a thin silver chain necklace beneath the open collar. Below, he wears clean white casual trousers with top-stitched front pockets. On his left wrist, he wears a prominent black smartwatch with a matching black band.
Background & Decor
The background is a clean, solid light grey wall surface, heavily adorned with stylized black outline-only doodles and graffiti art, giving it a creative space feel.
The doodles include:
Text: Two prominent graffiti-style bubble-letter text tags that spell "STAR" (one near the top-center, one at the bottom-right).
Objects:
A pair of large over-ear headphones (top-left).
A single 6-sided gaming die (mid-left).
The headstock and fretboard of a Fender Stratocaster-style electric guitar (mid-left).
Characters: Two distinct, simple cute cat face doodles (top-right and mid-right).
Accents: Multiple scattered five-pointed solid black stars and small sparkles.
Composition & Lighting
The image is a vertical composition, framed as if taken through a full-length mirror. A soft, continuous neon-like glowing outline (light blue) highlights the perimeter of the man's figure and each of the individual background doodles, making them appear to float and pop from the wall. The ambient lighting is even and cool.
Style & Technical Details
A highly polished digital illustration in a stylized semi-realistic aesthetic. The lines are extremely clean and sharp. The coloring is smooth with minimal gradients, focusing on clear, flat color blocks (black, white, grey) to create contrast. The skin and hair show detailed rendering maintain the overall clean, graphic art style. No film grain or texture is present.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Intense Assassin
prompts.prompt:
Hyper-realistic, dramatic black-and-white neo-noir assassin portrait illustrated in an ultra-detailed ink engraving / cross-hatching style.
Composition & Framing
Vertical 4:5 portrait.
Subject positioned on the left with 0% margin. occupies approximately the left 60–65% of the canvas.
The right 35–40% must remain clean white negative space.
Approximately 2/3 of the face is visible, cropped vertically through the centre of the eye.
Framing is a tight cinematic close-up:
• top crop slightly mid hair
• bottom crop just above the upper shoulder
Face orientation is almost straight toward the viewer, with a very slight forward angle.
The eyes must be the strong focal point.
Subjects Hair Styling (Corrected Fix)
Detect the user's hairstyle in the uploaded image and rebuild it with the same level of extreme detail as the assassin artwork, focusing on natural thickness and texture, not simplified or well-groomed.
Hair must appear:
• Natural thick, layered hairstyle (not thin or short)
• Dark colour
• High-volume, dynamic messy flow
• Slightly wet affected
• Highly textured with slightly meticulous individual strand rendering
• Large side-swept shape
Hair rendering requirements:
• Flowing hair with extreme detail
• Dynamic messy flow
• Subtle Individual, flowing hair strands meticulous rendering
• Loose strands falling naturally across the forehead
The hair should feel slightly wet and intense, like a noir action character, created with extreme attention to detail.
Beard Enhancement (Critical Fix)
Detect facial hair from the uploaded image and convert it into a rugged assassin beard texture.
Rules:
If clean shave → add light rugged stubble
If stubble → convert to short dense stubble
If beard → intensify beard density and texture with high volume
Beard rendering must include:
• visible hair strokes
• cross-hatched beard shadows
• strong jawline definition
• natural beard thickness
Beard must feel raw and masculine, not perfectly groomed.
Skin Texture
Add subtle gritty elements:
• light scars
• scratches
• ink splatter marks
• rough skin texture
Skin shading must use dense cross-hatching, not smooth gradients.
This creates a battle-hardened assassin aesthetic.
Lighting
Extreme noir chiaroscuro lighting.
• One side of the face has deep shadow due to the lighting effect
• other side strong illumination
Shadows formed by dense ink hatching.
Contrast must be very high.
Illustration Style
Ultra-detailed ink-engraving illustration.
Visible:
• cross-hatching
• ink scratches
• line textures
• rough engraving strokes
Inspired by:
• noir graphic novels
• vintage engraving art
• crime thriller posters
Background must remain clean white with large negative space.
Mood
Dark, brutal, cinematic assassin character.
Expression intense, dangerous.
